feast.note: The Beheading. The Russian calendar's 12 October keeps an event of his relics that this folder does not render, and an attestation holds one feast: «Перенесение из Мальты в Гатчину части древа Животворящего Креста Господня, Филермской иконы Божией Матери и десной руки св. Иоанна Крестителя (1799)» — the bringing from Malta to Gatchina, in 1799, of a part of the wood of the Life-giving Cross, of the Philermos icon of the Theotokos and of the Forerunner's right hand (https://days.pravoslavie.ru/Days/20261012.html, read 4 October 2026). That day prints a troparion and a kontakion for the translation of the hand, neither of which is recorded here, because they belong to the event rather than to the feast this row keeps. The same calendar keeps a second event of his relics, by the same reasoning not rendered here, AND PRINTS IT ON TWO CONSECUTIVE OF ITS OWN DAYS: «Третье обретение главы Предтечи и Крестителя Господня Иоанна (ок. 850).» — the third finding of his head, about 850 — stands first in the list of the Julian 23 May (https://days.pravoslavie.ru/Days/20260523.html) and first again in the list of the Julian 25 May (https://days.pravoslavie.ru/Days/20260525.html), both read 8 October 2026. Both pages were checked against their own text and both carry it; the 23 May page carries the Forerunner's proper Gospel readings beside it, «Предтечи: 2 Кор., 176 зач., IV, 6-15. Мф., 40 зач., XI, 2-15», and the 25 May page prints «Тропарь Предтечи» (глас 4) and «Кондак Предтечи» (глас 6), which are not recorded here, the row standing on another day. The calendar does not say why it keeps the finding twice.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 августа ст. ст. — «Усекновение главы Пророка, Предтечи и Крестителя Господня Иоанна»

feast.note: The Beheading. The Ohrid Prologue keeps his Synaxis on the day after Theophany: its heading for 7. јануар ст. ст. is „Свети Јован Крститељ.“ (https://www.pravoslavno.rs/index.php?q=citanja&datum=2026-01-20&prolog=1, read 3 October 2026), and the entry there tells of the Forerunner’s hand brought to Antioch. An attestation holds one feast, so he does not render on that day here. **A THIRD PROLOGUE DAY, WRITTEN AS A §4 SECOND-DAY NOTE AND NOT AS A ROW.** The same book keeps his **Nativity** on the Julian 24 June: its heading for 24. јун ст. ст. is „Рођење светог Јована Претече и Крститеља Господњег“, the Nativity of Saint John the Forerunner and Baptist of the Lord (https://www.pravoslavno.rs/index.php?q=citanja&datum=2026-07-07&prolog=1, read 5 October 2026), and the entry is a full life of the birth — Gabriel to Zacharias in the temple six months before Nazareth, the dumbness, the naming on the tablet, the house on the heights between Bethlehem and Hebron, Herod sending to the hill country after the child, Elizabeth hiding him, Zacharias killed between the porch and the temple and his blood congealing on the flagstones, Elizabeth dying in a cave, and the infant left alone in the wilderness. **An attestation holds one feast**, so the Beheading stays the day this row keeps and he does not render on 24 June here; the row above is **copied back out of this folder unchanged** and only this note is added, which is what §4 sanctions and the whole of what it sanctions — the day, the month, the calendar and the source are untouched, and the principal day is not moved. **AND THE BOOK ITSELF ENUMERATES HIS DAYS, WHICH NOTHING IN THIS WAVE HAS DONE BEFORE.** The entry closes „(в. 7. јануар ; 24. фебруар ; 25. мај; 29. август и 23. септембар).“ — see 7 January, 24 February, 25 May, 29 August and 23 September. So the Prologue keeps him on **six** days of its own year, and this folder’s own rows and notes had already found three of them independently: the Beheading on 29 August, which this row keeps, the Synaxis on 7 January, which the note above records, and now the Nativity. The two this reader has not opened are 24 February and 25 May, which the Romanian note above names as the findings of his head, and 23 September, which it names as the Conception and which doxologia also prints. **They are named and not read**: no page of them was fetched, and nothing is claimed about what they print. **NO ROWS AND NO TYPES.** Gabriel the archangel, Herod, and the Most Holy Virgin take no rows: an appearance is not a relation and a king in a life is not one either. Zacharias and Elizabeth are this man’s father and mother and are named in the paragraph added below; `.tmp/sr-prosechk.mjs` was run over that paragraph before it was written, and reports that the page’s own cross-linker finds **no** folder in it, because `matchableName` cuts a display name at its comma and what is left of «Zacharias, father of the Forerunner» and «Elizabeth, mother of the Forerunner» is one word, and `usableName` refuses a form of fewer than two. **So no `related` row is owed and none is written** — measured, not assumed, which is the §6 lesson. `types` untouched: the heading is the name of a feast and carries no rank word at all. `dates` untouched. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse, and this day also carries a poem, which is not a hymn either and is dealt with on the second entry.

hymns.text: Μνήμη δικαίου μετ᾽ ἐγκωμίων· σοὶ δὲ ἀρκέσει ἡ μαρτυρία τοῦ Κυρίου Πρόδρομε· ἀνεδείχθης γὰρ ὄντως καὶ Προφητῶν σεβασμιώτερος, ὅτι καὶ ἐν ῥείθροις βαπτίσαι κατηξιώθης τὸν κηρυττόμενον· ὅθεν τῆς ἀληθείας ὑπεραθλήσας, χαίρων εὐηγγελίσω καὶ τοῖς ἐν ᾅδῃ, Θεὸν φανερωθέντα ἐν σαρκί, τὸν αἴροντα τὴν ἁμαρτίαν τοῦ κόσμου, καὶ παρέχοντα ἡμῖν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

english.text: The memory of the righteous is kept with hymns of praise, but for thee, O Forerunner, the testimony of the Lord sufficeth; for thou wast shown to be truly more honourable than the prophets, in that thou wast counted worthy to baptize in the streams him whom thou didst proclaim. Wherefore, having suffered for the truth, thou didst rejoicing preach the good tidings even unto those in hades, that God had appeared in the flesh, taking away the sin of the world and granting us great mercy.

hymns.text: Ἡ τοῦ Προδρόμου ἔνδοξος ἀποτομή, οἰκονομία γέγονέ τις θεϊκή, ἵνα καὶ τοῖς ἐν ᾅδη τοῦ Σωτῆρος κηρύξῃ τὴν ἔλευσιν. Θρηνείτω οὖν Ἡρωδιάς, ἄνομον φόνον αἰτήσασα, οὐ νόμον γὰρ τὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ, οὐ ζῶντα αἰώνα ἠγάπησεν, ἀλλ᾽ ἐπίπλαστον πρόσκαιρον.

english.text: The glorious beheading of the Forerunner was a dispensation of God, that he might preach to those in hades also the coming of the Saviour. Let Herodias lament, then, who asked for a lawless murder; for she loved neither the law of God nor the living age, but a counterfeit and passing one.

hymns.text: Pomenirea dreptului cu laude, iar ţie destul îţi este mărturia Domnului, Înaintemergătorule. Că te-ai arătat cu adevărat mai cinstit şi decât proorocii. Că te-ai învrednicit a boteza în repejunele Iordanului pe Cel Propovăduit. Drept aceea, pentru adevăr nevoindu-te, bucurându-te, ai binevestit şi celor din iad pe Dumnezeu, Cel Ce S-a arătat în trup: pe Cel Ce a ridicat păcatul lumii şi ne-a dăruit nouă mare milă.

hymns.text: Память праведнаго с похвалами,/ тебе же довлеет свидетельство Господне, Предтече:/ показал бо ся еси воистинну и пророков честнейший,/ яко и в струях крестити сподобился еси Проповеданнаго./ Темже за истину пострадав, радуяся,/ благовестил еси и сущим во аде Бога, явльшагося плотию,/ вземлющаго грех мира// и подающаго нам велию милость.
